dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# Runtime Stage
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:arch

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG AZAHAR_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

ENV TITLE=Azahar \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/azahar-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  pacman -Sy --noconfirm --needed \
    git && \
  cd /tmp && \
  git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/azahar.git && \
  chown -R abc:abc azahar && \
  cd azahar && \
  sudo -u abc makepkg -sAci --skipinteg --noconfirm --needed && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  printf \
    "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" \
    > /build_version && \
  pacman -Scc --noconfirm && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/pacman/pkg/* \
    /var/lib/pacman/sync/*

# add local files and files from buildstage
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
VOLUME /config
EXPOSE 3001

notes.upstream:
This a minor release for the 2126 branch which primarily addresses a reported security advisory.
It also includes several newly backported improvements and fixes from the master branch.

Users are advised to update as soon as is convenient.

---

# Azahar 2126.2 Changelog

# All

- Addressed an oversight which allowed specially-crafted CIA files to execute arbitrary code in the host environment when locally installed by a user. | @PabloMK7 #2648 
  - Addresses the following GHSA report: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/security/advisories/GHSA-h74v-5mw8-qg8r
- Fixed an issue where the xBRZ texture filter would be applied incorrectly when using the Vulkan renderer, resulting in an incorrect appearance. | @OpenSauce04 #2647 
- Handling of large HTTP downloads within emulated 3DS applications has been improved, improving memory efficiency and stability. | @PabloMK7 #2515 
   - Fixes downloading large games from the eShop. 
- Added a new 3GX loader flag `allow_homebrew_load`, which allows loading 3GX plugins for homebrew apps if the plugin supports it. | @PabloMK7 #2649

# Desktop

- Various improvements to GDB and RPC servers, fixing certain issues and improving functionality. | @PabloMK7 #2631, #2640, #2633
  - For additional info, see individual PR descriptions.
  - Script developers will need to update the RPC client as this is a breaking change. 

# Android

- Fixed a crash which could occur if the `gpu_drivers` directory contained a subdirectory. | @ygordreyer #2592

# Technical

- Creating a copy of the kernel shared and config pages using svcMapProcessMemoryEx is now possible.
  - This is a technical accuracy change. Little to no end-user impact.
